title: The forged coupon, and other stories
sourceTitle: The forged coupon, and other stories
author: Tolstoy, Leo, graf
description: "The forged coupon, and other stories" by graf Leo Tolstoy is a collection written between 1902-1904 and published in 1910.
longDescription: The title novella follows a schoolboy's desperate act of forging a bond coupon to repay a debt. This single deception triggers a devastating chain reaction, touching dozens of lives and ultimately leading to murder.

authorInfo.bio: Tolstoy, Leo, graf (1828–1910) is the author of The forged coupon, and other stories. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
